authority: #K2-399 sec.2 step 1 (HARD PRECONDITION): declare AND machine-verify 'the board the placement gate probes' == 'the board the exam chain runs on'.

declaration.gate_probes: regen.mech_probe_moves -> builds a shadow of the repo and runs gen_v5 -> the produced board <gw>/mq_<tag>/placed.kicad_pcb (a GEN board).
declaration.verdict: BY CONSTRUCTION THEY ARE DIFFERENT FILES; the question is whether their LAYOUTS agree.

machine_check.method: mech_probe_moves([], work, 'base', return_board=True) -> the gate's base gen board; compare every MEMBER pad position against l14 (read-only pcbnew).
machine_check.conclusion: AT THE BASE the two boards AGREE on every member pad (118/118 identical) => the evaluation base is CONSISTENT at the base; a move admissible/inadmissible on one is evaluated against the SAME geometry.

correction_of_my_own_prior_overclaim.prior_claim: R1096 said the rigid-move gen failure exposed 'a REAL copper overlap in the generator's OWN layout' and blamed a gen-vs-l14 divergence.
correction_of_my_own_prior_overclaim.correction: the base layouts are identical (118/118). The gen failure's own message shows C88.1 at the MOVED position but J13.2 at its UNMOVED position, i.e. the rigid move was applied to PART of the entry set - so the overlap is an artefact of an INCOMPLETE application of the move, NOT of a base divergence.

unresolved_named.what: in the rigid probe (one delta, all 25 refs) the generator ended up with some refs moved and others not (evidence: the S1 PAD_OVERLAP message pairs a moved C88.1 with an unmoved J13.2); edit_placement_at edited pm_gate/project.yaml (58 lines) but the generator's effective placement for J13 did not change.
unresolved_named.needed: a machine check that AFTER edit_placement_at every requested ref's placement actually changed in the placement source (a per-ref verification), before the gate trusts a 'partial' move.

gen_failed_base_invariant.rule: an EMPTY violations reading is NEVER a clean reading: mech_probe_moves already NAMES its failure with gen_failed/gen_exit, and rearrange_probe requires gen_exit == 0 (guard test_C398_*). This is now a BASE INVARIANT for every gate consumer.
gen_failed_base_invariant.status: asset on file (R1096), regression pending a gate-probe receipt.
